Third-party aggregator listings (e.g. Pickleheads) claim lights are present but that page 403'd on direct fetch, so I could not confirm it myself.

courts.reserve: Rec (rec.us) — https://www.rec.us/organizations/el-segundo-recreation . Per https://www.elsegundorecparks.gov/parks-facilities/park-facilities-reservations (quoted): "Rental requests for tennis, paddle tennis, pickleball, and racquetball courts are automatically approved, and payment by credit card is collected at the time of your request." Not ActiveNet or CourtReserve — it's the Rec.us platform ("Welcome to our NEW registration and reservation system!", migrated recently). Phone: 310-524-2700 (Checkout Building).
courts.access: Public City of El Segundo facility. Free first-come walk-on when a court isn't reserved or in a program; reservations and scheduled programs (leagues, clinics, drop-ins) take priority. Registered drop-in players must check in at the Checkout Building for a wristband before playing.
courts.notes: Drop-in sessions use a 'paddle saddle' rack system — quoted from https://www.rec.us/organizations/el-segundo-recreation?search=pickleball: "Players use our paddle saddle system to organize games. Simply place your paddle in the rack when you're ready to play. Four players are selected at a time to take the court, and when a game ends, those players rotate out while the next four paddles move in." This is the same queue mechanic PointCast's Manhattan Middle School 'Paddles in the rack?' confirmation is modeled on — worth calling out to Mike directly. Separately, the City also runs an 'El Segundo Pickleball' league (not drop-in) on rec.us/elsegundorecparks.gov: 4 divisions — Women's Doubles ($480/team, Wed/Thu AM 8:45-10:45 & 11-1), Mixed Doubles ($480/team, Wed/Thu nights 6-8), Men's Doubles (Tue nights 6-8), All Gender 4.5/4.5+ (Mon nights 7-10) — new teams email cthrasher@elsegundo.org. There's also a 'Pickleball Instructional Clinic' (3 sections, beginner-oriented per its description), 'Live Ball Pickleball' (1 section), and 'Women's Round Robin Pickleball with Instruction' (2.5+ and 3.0+, 2 sections) on rec.us — not itemized as dropins below since they're taught/paid classes, not open drop-in play. No beginner-level *drop-in* session currently exists in the Sept/Oct 2026 schedule — only Advanced and Intermediate (3.0 / 3.5); beginners are directed to the Instructional Clinic instead.

courts.courts: None found. The city's own park list (Jane Addams, Rogers/Anderson, William Green, Hogan, Hopper Parks) does not show a pickleball amenity in the official parks directory.
courts.notes: A live Change.org petition is asking LA County to add dedicated pickleball courts at neighboring Alondra Park (unincorporated, between Lawndale and Gardena) — evidence of unmet demand, not an existing court. The nearest real public options to Lawndale are the Hawthorne sites above and Redondo Beach's Alta Vista/Perry/Anderson parks. The private Lawndale Club (formerly Lawndale Park, in Greensboro/membership club) has courts but is not public. UNVERIFIED that no court exists anywhere in city limits — this reflects what could be found in this research pass, not a certainty.

courts.name: Westchester Recreation Center (Westchester Playa Pickleball)
courts.address: 7000 W Manchester Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90045
courts.courts: 8 dedicated outdoor hard courts, permanent lines, portable nets — an LA city rec center court complex operated in partnership as a fully staffed pickleball program (4 beginner + 4 intermediate/advanced courts, staff directs players by skill).
courts.reserve: Book programs/open play via westchesterpickleball.playbypoint.com. Rec center itself: (310) 670-7473.
courts.notes: Structurally this is the closest real-world comp to what Mike is describing for El Segundo: a staffed program with fixed weekday open-play windows split by skill level, including a Friday 9am–12pm slot that echoes his claimed El Segundo Friday 9-12 window. The open-play day/time grid below came from a search-engine synthesis of the playbypoint site rather than a page opened directly — verify before publishing as fact.

courts.name: Culver City Paddle Tennis Courts
courts.address: Culver Blvd & Elenda St, Culver City, CA 90230
courts.courts: 3 outdoor hard courts, chalk pickleball lines drawn over paddle-tennis courts; BYO net (available nets aren't height-adjustable for pickleball). Lights on-site.
courts.reserve: None — free, no reservation option.
courts.notes: Culver City has separately approved a plan to expand shared pickleball/paddle-tennis court access citywide and is developing a new Racquet Court Center at Culver City Park (dedicated pickleball, paddle tennis, tennis) — that expansion news comes from a local news article, UNVERIFIED against a city source directly. Other nearby options if this one is full: Culver West Alexander Park (2 dedicated courts) and Fox Hills Park (4 courts, BYO net).
